I'm seeing this duplicated again, in real time.

I want to point out you submitted this under Feature Requests instead of Bug Reports. This seems like it should be a bug report.

Also duplicate reports are definitely occurring. I get 2 notifications every time an account I reported has been actioned. I don't report that many accounts so there is no way it is a coincidence every time I get 2 reports.

This is still ongoing.

Duplicated by: https://feedback.vrchat.com/open-beta/p/1833-duplicate-moderation-report-notifications

details:
I have been suspicious and become fairly certain for a longer while now (almost) every "Moderation Report Closed" notification gets duplicated. For example, these two notifications created today at 13:40:56 UTC:

```

2025.12.29 21:44:37 Debug      -  Received Notification: <Notification from username:, sender user id: to usr_6fa4abc5-9952-4a0a-97de-b3598fbf6a5c of type: moderation, id: not_ad184441-20a7-42cc-bfd7-b3e41c7d7f53, created at: 12/29/2025 13:40:56 UTC, details: {{}}, type:moderation, m seen:False, message: "The group associated with a report you submitted was actioned by the moderation team. This may be as a result of a report you submitted or from the report of another user. Thank you for helping to keep VRChat safe!">

```

When viewing closed reports in the VRChat client, only 1 recently reported group had its report closed and actioned (the group was deleted or set private). Then this notification appeared twice, some hours later.

I think these duplicate notices also occur with avatars, emojis and stickers. I think I've observed this to have been occurring mostly since November 2025.
